items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Guy Kelly, and Red Carey, you heard of him, Carey, played saxophone.

ctx.x: I can't think of who that would be. His name's Stone, anybody tell you.
Guy Kelly, and Red Carey, you heard of him, Carey, played saxophone. Red Carey? Yeah, you never heard of him either?
I can't place him, I'll play him.
